state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`, ending in `## floor`).

**The scheduler and channel scans are fixed in code.** `Scheduler::run`'s parked sweep reads `TaskTree::sweep` (tasks marked, or parked while cancelled, since the last sweep) and not the whole parked set. `TaskNode::children` is a `BTreeSet`, so a child ending is O(log siblings). `nvs_host::channel::Waiters` is ticket-keyed, so `Drop for Waiter` is O(log waiters). `nvs-stdlib`'s channel registry is keyed by channel, then ticket, so a send reads only its own waiters. The stdlib channel gap record is deleted. Ladders `benches/scaling/scheduler/fan-out.nvs` and `waiters.nvs` are new; neither has a before and after yet, because `target/release/nvs.exe` was built before these fixes.

**9 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red, one of them `data/gaps/nvs-host/a-scheduler-turn-scans-every-parked-task.json`, which now owes only the `parked.nvs` ladder and the figures. `bun nv scaling --check` over all ladders was not run this session either.

**Every task is charged its 1 MiB stack** (`data/gaps/nvs-host/a-task-is-charged-a-whole-stack.json`), so 256 parked tasks exceed the 256M default cap and `waiters.nvs` stops at 128. With an explicit `--config` the charge also reaches tasks that finish at once: 4096 children of `Core\Task::map` exceed a 1G cap, and use 26 MB without `--config`. Not checked why the two differ.
